title_en: Character Riddles (9/20): Light Born of the Sun
note_en: Dad explains that repeating a word often makes it softer and more affectionate: 星星 "little stars," 宝宝 "baby," 狗狗 "doggy." English does this with endings like -y or -ie, or with "little"; Chinese simply says the syllable twice. In writing, the single form stays: 星球 "planet," 星系 "galaxy."
